summary: Master competition law and fair market conduct with practical tools, compliance workflows, and board-ready reporting. Enrol to strengthen market discipline.
lede: Fair competition training helps commercial, legal, and procurement professionals manage competition-law risks in everyday decisions. Participants practice identifying cartel and bid-rigging indicators, assessing market definition and dominance, and screening mergers, using tools such as SSNIP analysis and evidence review. They also develop practical compliance workflows and investigation-ready records for pricing, tenders, and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch commercial, legal, procurement, regulatory, or investigation processes and need a practical way to manage competition-law risk.
prerequisites: To benefit fully, you should bring familiarity with commercial contracts, procurement processes, pricing decisions, or regulatory compliance work. A laptop and spreadsheet software are recommended for the exercises, because you will work through market-screening templates, merger trackers, and monitoring dashboards.
